forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {低|ひく}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to lower; to reduce; to bring down
definitions.explanation: To make something lower in level, degree, volume, or position. Used for physical height, sound volume, risk levels, standards, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{低|ひく}めて⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: To speak in a lowered voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{低|ひく}めて⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: To advance with a low posture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{低|ひく}める⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{安全対策|あんぜんたいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}した→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
examples.english: Safety measures were strengthened to reduce the risk of accidents.

notes: Ichidan verb. The transitive counterpart of {低|ひく}まる (to become lower). Common collocations: ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{低|ひく}める (lower one's voice), ⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{低|ひく}める (reduce risk), ⟦ハードル→ハードル：11117_haadoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{低|ひく}める (lower the bar/hurdle), ⟦{敷居|しきい}→敷居：06937_shikii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{低|ひく}める (lower the threshold, make something more accessible). Compare with ⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧, which is more general and everyday; {低|ひく}める specifically focuses on making something lower in height, level, or degree.
